title: anthropic.model
description: The `model` member of a recorded anthropic/messages wire request, preserved when the audit-direction decode edge lifts the request into the canonical IR. The model name is routing data, never canonical content (a ChatRequest carries no model field; the front door binds the resource, architecture 3.4) — this key keeps the audit trail of which model the archived call targeted without pretending the name is portable.
x-ocai-promotion: none expected — routing data stays out of the request IR by design (3.4)
